240-4785-5470-8227.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
240-4785-5470-8227.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Loot by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loot ability, giving Loot -2/-0 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

3490-4885-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4885-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2577-5256-6763-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-5256-6763-7084.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2033-3249-4054--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-4054--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the creature castable for one mana from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature spell from your graveyard by paying it mana cost.
When you cast that creature or when it enters, Primeval Bounty triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1365-4247-4853-6009.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one artifact card in hand.
Arsenal Thresher does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-4247-4853-6009.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Arsenal Thresher persist until end of turn.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Arsenal Thresher.
When Arsenal Thresher dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Arsenal Thresher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then choosing to reveal at least one artifact card from your hand to remove the -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

3590-4222-5268.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald by tapping it, adding {U}.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.

2557-3129-4365-4826-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2011-4076-7824.easyPrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
2011-4076-7824.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block and kill it.
Najeela and Burakos triggers.
Resolve the Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Burakos trigger, creating five Treasure tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose 4 life.
Activate the five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7829-7833.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7829-7833.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

4067-7801.description:
Activate Spock, Logical Choice by tapping it, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Spock, Logical Choice.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

390-670-1619-3122.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
390-670-1619-3122.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Undercover Operative and Hulking Metamorph each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Undercover Operative trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Hulking Metamorph trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
390-670-1619-3122.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

1368-3499-5477-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3499-5477-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2034-3175-5617.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Repeat.

57-283-1753-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-1753-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

104-3490-4268-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-3490-4268-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

104-4186-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-4186-6097.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1580-2060-5686-6701.description:
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
1580-2060-5686-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

1479-3534-5621.notablePrerequisites:
You control seven or more lands with different names.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3534-5621.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Field of the Dead, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Field of the Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3188-3490-4050-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
3188-3490-4050-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Social Climber indestructible.
3188-3490-4050-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

56-1417-5256-6255.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-1417-5256-6255.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Bridge from Below and Zahur trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-1417-5256-6255.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

643-3951-5686-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-3951-5686-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

360-1274-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-1274-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1912-4499-5421.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Redcap Thief.
When Redcap Thief enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Kaslem, Deepest Growth // Temple of Cultivation

225-2034-3470-5552.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least ten permanents.
225-2034-3470-5552.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ojer Kaslem, adding {C}{C}.
When Ojer Kaslem dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as Temple of Cultivation.
When Temple of Cultivation enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Temple of Cultivation.
Activate Temple of Cultivation's second ability by paying {2}{G} and tapping it, transforming Temple of Cultivation into Ojer Kaslem.
Repeat.

2909-3152-5570.notablePrerequisites:
Nardole has at least four counters on it.
Nardole does not have summoning sickness.
2909-3152-5570.description:
Activate Nardole by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast noncreature spells.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Nardole.
Resolve Mind Games, tapping target artifact, creature or land and returning Mind Games to your hand.
Repeat.
If Nardole has at least five counters on it, this combo nets infinite {U} that can only be spent to cast noncreature spells, and you may target any other creature using Chakram Retriever's trigger.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

178-3259-4359.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
178-3259-4359.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Adeline as attackers.
Adeline triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2060-5455.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler has at least five +1/+1 counters on it.
2060-5455.description:
Activate Bristly Bill by paying {3}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
If Crystalline Crawler has six or more +1/+1 counters on it to start the combo, this combo results in infinite colored mana.

1283-1496-4078-4242-4659.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1283-1496-4078-4242-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

1183-1988-2034.notablePrerequisites:
Blade of the Bloodchief attached to Pentavus.
You control at least one additional creature.
1183-1988-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Blade of the Bloodchief triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1965-3388-4600.manaNeeded: {2}{G}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
1965-3388-4600.description:
Cast Moritte of the Frost by paying {2}{G}{U}{U} plus commander tax (if applicable).
Choose to have Moritte of the Frost enter the battlefield as a copy of Omarthis with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Omarthis's first triggered ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Moritte of the Frost triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
End the loop by declining to put a +1/+1 counter on one of your creatures.
Warning: Omarthis's last ability can increase the risk of losing by drawing from an empty library if you place enough counters on them.

1530-1927-2963-3544.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
1530-1927-2963-3544.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turh after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Auramancer.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

725-1074.notablePrerequisites: Aura of Dominion attached to King Macar.
725-1074.description:
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping King Macar, untapping King Macar.
King Macar triggers, exiling any opposing creature and creating a Gold token.
Activate the Gold by sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

776-1329-1596-4534.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Barrage Ogre do not have summoning sickness.
776-1329-1596-4534.description:
Tap Barrage Ogre, sacrificing Engineered Explosives to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Engineered Explosives.
Cast Engineered Explosives.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

690-3966.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
690-3966.description:
Gain life.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Exquisite Blood triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.
